item.text: {"formal_eligible":false,"events":[{"memory_id":"M01","state":"used","affected_behavior":"Clarification answers were copied verbatim under `A(原话)`, with separate `Agent 解读` entries.","rationale":"Directly applicable to the Gate 1 clarification log and visibly reflected in Q1–Q4."},{"memory_id":"M02","state":"used","affected_behavior":"Clarification questions, requirements, and scope rules were kept focused and stated once.","rationale":"Applied while authoring a relatively small configuration requirement without adding lengthy repeated guidance."},{"memory_id":"M03","state":"used","affected_behavior":"Repository specs, configuration code, classifier code, and the originating auto-mode change were investigated before Q1.","rationale":"This grounding established that the classifier currently inherits the Agent/run model and that no dedicated approval-model setting exists."},{"memory_id":"M04","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No agent-role or workflow design was added.","rationale":"The run authored a product first document, not an agent workflow, role prompt, or operating skill."},{"memory_id":"M05","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No implementation-workflow simplification or delegation policy was specified.","rationale":"Implementation and its workflow were outside the frozen spec phase."},{"memory_id":"M06","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No fix loop, validation ledger, or post-review revalidation policy was defined.","rationale":"There was no implementation or review phase."},{"memory_id":"M07","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No prototype or frontend interaction contract was created.","rationale":"The change concerns Gateway configuration and model routing, not frontend work."},{"memory_id":"M08","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No Web IM visual or interaction styling decisions were made.","rationale":"The brief did not introduce or alter a content-centric UI surface."},{"memory_id":"M09","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No technical design structure or visualization was produced.","rationale":"The envelope stopped at Gate 1 and prohibited design work."},{"memory_id":"M10","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No architecture or design review was performed.","rationale":"Reviewers and design review were expressly out of scope."},{"memory_id":"M11","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"The spec did not prescribe a shared implementation owner or cross-product regression mechanism.","rationale":"Implementation ownership belongs to design, and Owner evidence established that Coding CLI must remain outside the product scope."},{"memory_id":"M12","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No bugfix RCA or originating-feature repair analysis was undertaken.","rationale":"The request was classified as a new feature, not a bugfix."},{"memory_id":"M13","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No runtime reproduction or live acceptance was conducted.","rationale":"The task ended at the specification gate before implementation or acceptance."},{"memory_id":"M14","state":"used","affected_behavior":"Acceptance scenarios stayed at operator- or user-observable behavior and avoided field names, APIs, modules, and internal topology.","rationale":"The spec describes configured model selection, startup failure, approval behavior, and observable model-service request records while deferring implementation details."},{"memory_id":"M15","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No canonical-spec merge, architecture update, or archival lifecycle was specified.","rationale":"This was an active first document, not change completion."},{"memory_id":"M16","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No retrospective timeline or incident analysis was produced.","rationale":"The task was neither an incident nor a retrospective."},{"memory_id":"M17","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No new repository governance rule or enforcement mechanism was introduced.","rationale":"The structural self-check validated the document but did not add contract enforcement."},{"memory_id":"M18","state":"overridden","affected_behavior":"Omitting the new PA setting preserves the existing Agent/run-model behavior instead of requiring one canonical configured model.","rationale":"The Owner explicitly rejected fallback to the PA default and required backward-compatible omission semantics; that task-specific decision outweighed the general preference against compatibility fallbacks. Its clear-failure principle still aligned with the separate invalid-explicit-model decision, but that behavior was grounded by Owner answer O03."},{"memory_id":"M19","state":"used","affected_behavior":"Scope was restricted to Personal Assistant and only the automatic tool-approval classifier; Coding CLI, normal run generation, deterministic safety rules, and human approval were explicit non-goals.","rationale":"This directly prevented unrelated cross-product and permission-system expansion."},{"memory_id":"M20","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No autonomous implementation or validation loop was specified.","rationale":"Implementation was prohibited by the task envelope."},{"memory_id":"M21","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No external reference implementation was consulted or adapted.","rationale":"The brief named no reference, and network or outside-workspace access was prohibited."},{"memory_id":"M22","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No run timeout or watchdog behavior was changed.","rationale":"The feature concerns approval-classifier model selection only."},{"memory_id":"M23","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No active-run steering semantics were specified.","rationale":"Steering and multi-client message injection were unrelated to the brief."},{"memory_id":"M24","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"No end-to-end test catalog or test strategy was defined.","rationale":"Test design belongs to later phases and was outside Gate 1."}]}
